A day of the week — a VALUE vocabulary (the seven ISO-8601 days as individuals); projects to schema:dayOfWeek.

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:QualityValue

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:DayOfWeek as a specialized kind of gufo:QualityValue. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
